QuestInfo.name: The Hidden Truth about the Past
QuestInfo.1: Andy the Time Traveler has requested that you travel to Midnight Harbor in the year 2099 to investigate and if possible, destroy the giant robot, if it exists.
QuestInfo.2: Andy the Time Traveler wanted you to go to Year 2099: Harbor and eliminate the Giant Robot. You traveled to the appointed place and time, and eliminated it.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 106,900\nIdentity of the Missile now available.\n

0.0: According to the records I found, a giant robot appeared in the year 2099. At the time, this was regarded as a silly rumor, but I have a hunch it's not something we should overlook. Please travel to year 2099 and investigate.

yes.0: Oh, and if you find the robot for any reason, destroy it. That would be a great victory for the future.

no.0: This is serious business. If you've lost interest, now would be a good time for you to quit and go about your business.

1.0: So? Was there really a giant robot?\r\n#b#L0#Yes, there really was. As you requested, I destroyed it.#l\n#k
1.1: You did? Thank you. I wish this were the end to our problem.

mob.0: Please travel to year 2099 and investigate the robot that appeared in the harbor. If you happen to run into the robot, please destroy it.
